'''N5-D3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] stationed at the [[Upper Markaran Outpost]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|world]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
